scale_selection: The first-signal core target is 45% of its 5%-of-NAV member budget. At the 2023-03-27 known close, one TQQQ share implies approximately USD 1124 of account NAV. USD 1000 and 1250 pre-straddle this indicative whole-share threshold; USD 10000 reuses the completed Phase 4 result; USD 100000 is one larger round scale. These points are fixed before the new replays and are not selected by future returns.
variable_under_test: initial research principal and consequent path-dependent NAV, share counts, funding, fees and member activation
fixed_commission_status: No nonzero fixed-commission contract or account-specific minimum fee is approved for this frozen experiment; report the missing sensitivity rather than assuming a real broker fee.
loss_budget_policy: no_new_portfolio_loss_limit; unchanged internal TQQQ guard only
window: 2023-03-28/2024-12-31; same 444 common sessions and full original core warmup
reuse_rule: The USD 10000 paths must be read from the SHA-bound completed Phase 4 private summary and ledgers; do not rerun them. Other points use the same builder and account recursion from cash-only initial state.
interpretation_limit: All points share a seen development window. Initial principal examples are not personal account settings, optimization candidates, or evidence that larger capital improves returns. With zero fixed commission and no locked initial holdings, those two effects remain untested by this slice.
